scope: Rakuten Ichiba / Rakuten Affiliate Japan catalog reads; distinct from Rakuten Advertising global.
liveReplayBlocker: The current official Rakuten Web Service Item Search and Genre Search endpoints require a registered app applicationId and accessKey. No caller-owned app credentials or Rakuten Affiliate ID were supplied to this task; no authenticated request was sent.

itemSearch.auth: applicationId query + required accessKey; header is supported for accessKey and is used by this client

price.itemPrice: Listing-level JPY decimal integer string; not asserted to be a selected variant/SKU price.
price.itemPriceBaseField: item_price_min1 => all-item minimum basis; item_price_min2 => searchable-item minimum basis; item_price_min3 => purchasable-item minimum basis.

itemSearch.commission: affiliateRate is read as item-specific API data when present; no fixed fee is assumed
itemSearch.affiliate: affiliateId optional; affiliateUrl returned only when caller supplies it. The docs note itemUrl can equal affiliateUrl when affiliateId is included.
itemSearch.affiliateTargetPatternFinding: Rakuten documents affiliate URLs with pc and m item URL targets in its Product Search API. The Ichiba Item Search adapter only parses such targets if they are present in its own response; it does not compose a URL from the separate Product Search contract.

appRegistration.finding: A Rakuten account login is needed to register an application. Each app receives its paired applicationId and accessKey; the guide says one Affiliate ID is issued per developer.

attribution.finding: Rakuten Web Services requires an unmodified supplied branding/credit snippet on apps using its API.

client.transport: direct HTTPS GET; accessKey header-only; applicationId query required by Rakuten; redirects manual; no browser or cookies
client.canonicalTarget: Checks direct API itemUrl or static pc/m target from the same API item row against HTTPS Rakuten Ichiba host, matching shopCode path, and an exact path segment matching the itemCode suffix. A target lacking that literal comparable item key yields canonicalUrl=null and targetVerified=false. The affiliateUrl is retained separately; no tracking URL is fetched and no path is synthesized. No slug transformation or leaf equivalence is assumed.
client.secretHandling: No credentials, raw URLs, query values, response bodies, or affiliate IDs are persisted in this evidence file.
